assetProvenance.constraints: HTML owns labels and semantics; do not bake in UI, text, logos, charts, candlesticks, or claims.

narrative.overview: AMT Auction Atlas is a late-night market cartographer's field book: a near-black plotted terrain with warm bone annotations and sparse mineral inks. It makes the course's causal chain spatial—context, location, trigger, risk, and review are territories on one route—while keeping detailed reading on a visually nearer, motionless plane. The system is precise rather than ornamental. Fine contours, survey bearings, coordinate labels, stage pictograms, and engraved terrain establish a working atlas; each mark must either orient the learner or encode lesson state. The atlas preserves the product truth: 37 subtitle-reviewed lessons and the title-derived chapter 15 are visually distinguishable, and no visual device implies trading performance or certainty.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous plotted route across five learning territories.
Near-black survey ground, warm bone type, and restrained mineral phase inks.
Engraved terrain behind the atlas; a quiet, fixed reading sheet in front.
Stage pictograms, numbered plaques, coordinate nodes, and dashed conceptual bearings.
Honest source-state marks, keyboard focus, reduced motion, and narrow-screen horizontal map travel.

rules.name: Cartography Before Cards
rules.body: Express hierarchy with route layers, coordinates, bearings, plaques, and editorial rules; do not default to a dashboard of interchangeable cards.

rules.name: Sparse Mineral
rules.body: Use a phase ink on coordinates, route segments, stage plaques, status marks, and small headings; large surfaces remain ink or bone.

rules.name: Source Honesty
rules.body: A title-derived lesson uses Derived Orange with a dashed mark. Never render it with the solid subtitle-reviewed grammar.

rules.name: Two-Plane Type
rules.body: Smiley Sans names the terrain; the neutral Chinese sans explains and operates it. Do not use the display face for dense paragraphs.

rules.name: Instrument Label
rules.body: Uppercase English abbreviations and numeric metadata may use the compact monospace label role with tabular figures; preserve Chinese readability everywhere else.

rules.name: Persistent Place
rules.body: Keep atlas context visible whenever the viewport permits; lesson changes update the reader without a page reload or loss of route position.

rules.name: Horizontal Atlas
rules.body: On narrow screens, preserve route geometry through horizontal travel. Do not squeeze labels until they collide or replace the map with cards.

rules.name: Quiet Reader
rules.body: Background terrain may drift remotely, but the reading plane must remain still. Under reduced-motion preference, all animation and transition duration collapses to effectively zero.

rules.name: Semantic Circle
rules.body: Circular geometry always means a plotted point, stage, or location state; never use it as arbitrary decoration.

rules.name: Plaque
rules.body: A stage identity combines a circular line pictogram with a rectangular phase-color name plaque and a compact numeric tab. Keep these elements as one grammar.

rules.name: One Active Bearing
rules.body: Only the selected lesson receives the strongest ring, bright route segment, and related bearings. Competing active treatments weaken orientation.

dos: Preserve the visual chain from market context to review as one route.
Use real phase color and coordinate states to encode meaning.
Keep the reader text measure quiet and stable while the atlas changes.
Preserve Chinese copy legibility and English AMT abbreviations.
Mark chapter 15 as title-derived with the dashed orange grammar.
Keep focus visible and honor reduced-motion preference.
Extend the pictogram/plaque/coordinate grammar to future glossary, notes, progress, and quiz surfaces.
donts: Replace the atlas with a generic card grid or KPI dashboard.
Add candlestick decoration, neon cyberpunk glow, gradients, colored blobs, or ornamental charts.
Flood large surfaces with phase colors; mineral inks are notation.
Bake labels or claims into the terrain image.
Imply trading outcomes, certainty, or source coverage the product does not have.
Collapse narrow-screen nodes into unreadable overlaps; keep the horizontal rail.
Animate the reader, ignore keyboard focus, or rely on motion alone to communicate state.

components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:420px;max-width:100%;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong,rgba(238,231,217,.26));background:rgba(238,231,217,.025);color:var(--bone,#eee7d9);font:13px/1.4 'Microsoft YaHei UI','PingFang SC',sans-serif}.ds-search svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:var(--bone-faint,#858b84);stroke-width:1.7}.ds-search input{min-width:0;flex:1;border:0;outline:0;color:inherit;background:transparent;font:inherit}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:var(--bone-faint,#858b84)}.ds-search kbd{padding:2px 6px;color:var(--bone-faint,#858b84);border:1px solid var(--line,rgba(238,231,217,.14));font:11px/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace}.ds-search:focus-within{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#fff0a6);outline-offset:3px}

components.css: .ds-node{--ds-phase:var(--teal,#56c9bb);display:grid;justify-items:center;width:88px;padding:8px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--bone,#eee7d9);font-family:'Microsoft YaHei UI','PingFang SC',sans-serif;text-align:center;cursor:pointer}.ds-node-core{width:13px;height:13px;border:2px solid var(--ink,#0b0e0d);border-radius:50%;background:var(--ink,#0b0e0d);outline:3px solid var(--ds-phase);outline-offset:3px;transition:transform .2s cubic-bezier(.18,.78,.18,1)}.ds-node-code{margin-top:10px;font:600 11px/1 ui-monospace,monospace}.ds-node-title{margin-top:4px;color:var(--bone,#eee7d9);font-size:11px;line-height:1.3;font-weight:700}.ds-node:hover .ds-node-core{transform:scale(1.2)}.ds-node:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#fff0a6);outline-offset:3px}
